checks.text: On first load the page shows the heading "Tower of Hanoi", the text "Moves: 0", the text "Best: 0", and the three pegs labelled "Peg A", "Peg B" and "Peg C" with Peg A holding the disks "3", "2" and "1" from bottom to top.
With the default 3-disk board, clicking the button "Move 1 A→C" moves disk 1 from Peg A to Peg C; the text "Moves: 1" appears, Peg A now holds disks "3" and "2", and Peg C holds disk "1".

Continuing from A2, clicking "Move 2 A→B" then "Move 1 C→B" then "Move 3 A→C" then "Move 1 B→A" then "Move 2 B→C" then "Move 1 A→C" completes the puzzle; the text "Moves: 7" appears, the text "Best: 7" appears, and the text "Solved in 7 moves" is shown.
After solving, clicking the button "Restart" resets the board to the initial 3-disk state, the text "Moves: 0" appears, the text "Solved in 7 moves" is gone, and the text "Best: 7" remains.

Changing the field labelled "Disks" to "4" and clicking the button "Apply" resets the board to a 4-disk puzzle; the text "Moves: 0" appears, Peg A holds disks "4", "3", "2" and "1", and the text "Solved in 7 moves" is gone.
With the 4-disk board, clicking the button "Move 1 A→B" moves disk 1 from Peg A to Peg B; the text "Moves: 1" appears, Peg A holds disks "4", "3" and "2", and Peg B holds disk "1".
With the 4-disk board, clicking the button "Move 2 A→C" is disabled and shows the message "Illegal move: disk 2 cannot go on disk 1"; the text "Moves: 0" remains unchanged.
The tab labelled "History" shows a table with the header "Move" and "Action". After making the single legal move "Move 1 A→B" on the 4-disk board, the table contains the row "1" and "1 A→B".
Reload keeps the best score and disk count: after solving the 3-disk puzzle (Best: 7) and reloading, the page shows the text "Best: 7" and the field labelled "Disks" still contains "3".
